comment: Scenes driven once per runtime: dom, canvas and official. Each row is an independent page load; simultaneous display has one document rAF cadence.
Every public rig is built by scripts/fetch-assets.sh as a matched skeleton.model.json, skeleton.json, skeleton.atlas and original PNGs.
Grid scenes share one official canvas/context, while many deliberately uses one per independent player and reports lost contexts and actually drawn players.
Headless output has deterministic counters only, every timing null and measurement unavailable labelled explicitly. No headless result belongs in README Measured.
--corpus DIR preserves local scenes.json and paired builds outside this repository; query model may name a model URL and query json/atlas overrides a nonstandard pair.

scenes.name: 1 meshed rig animating
scenes.why: the deform tier working every frame against the canvas mode's one-pass draw

scenes.name: 16 meshed rigs animating
scenes.why: an all-mesh grid — the canvas mode's home ground

scenes.name: 36 meshed rigs animating
scenes.why: between 16 and 64, so a crossover has somewhere to be seen rather than jumped over

scenes.name: 64 meshed rigs animating
scenes.why: the page's cap: the heaviest deform load either mode is asked for here

scenes.name: 1 meshed rig animating (canvas2d)
scenes.why: the DOM tier's canvas2d mesh backend, and the one real Safari struggles with

scenes.name: 16 meshed rigs animating (canvas2d)
scenes.why: the canvas2d backend under a grid — the per-triangle path's own scaling

scenes.name: 1 held pose
scenes.why: dirty-skip home ground: unchanged meshes reuse their raster, an unchanged frame is reused

scenes.name: 1 rigid rig animating
scenes.why: region attachments only — pure and one CSS matrix per slot on the DOM side

scenes.name: 16 rigid rigs animating
scenes.why: a grid of rigid rigs: element count and compositing against one canvas per rig

scenes.name: 64 rigid rigs animating
scenes.why: the cap, where the DOM side holds one element per drawn slot of 64 rigs (walk declares 15 slots)

scenes.name: 8 small players
scenes.why: independent players, each clipped to its own cell

scenes.name: 20 small players
scenes.why: past the browser's ~16-context cap: the package shares one context; official players have independent contexts and report actual survivors
